title: The Defeat of Satan
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The defeat of Satan means that the devil’s rebellion, accusation, deception, and opposition will be finally judged and ended by God. Satan is a defeated enemy under Christ’s authority, awaiting final punishment.
summary: The defeat of Satan means that the devil’s rebellion, accusation, deception, and opposition will be finally judged and ended by God. Satan is a defeated enemy under Christ’s authority, awaiting final punishment.
christFocus: Jesus Christ defeats Satan through His death, resurrection, reign, and return. The seed of the woman crushes the serpent, disarms the powers, and will cast Satan into final judgment.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Satan is real, but he is not equal with God. His power is limited, his rebellion is judged, and his final defeat is certain.

The promise of Satan’s defeat begins as early as Genesis, where the seed of the woman is promised to crush the serpent. This promise finds its fulfillment in Christ.

At the cross, Christ triumphed over the powers and broke Satan’s condemning hold over His people. Believers overcome by the blood of the Lamb, not by their own strength.

Satan’s final judgment is certain. He will be cast into the lake of fire, and his deception, accusation, and opposition will end forever.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people ignore spiritual evil, while others become obsessed with it. This doctrine keeps both truth and proportion: Satan is dangerous, but Christ is supreme.

The defeat of Satan gives courage to believers under temptation, accusation, fear, and spiritual battle. The enemy’s rage is real, but his doom is sure.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand firm in Christ’s victory. Do not live in fear, superstition, or obsession with darkness. Resist the devil by faith, cling to the Gospel, use the Word, pray, and remember that the God of peace will crush Satan under His people’s feet.
